page: Microsoft Azure E64as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eav6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, delivering 64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores with 2 threads per core at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results place this server in the top 10% tier for Geekbench multi-core performance, image processing, and prompt processing for small 135M LLM models. It demonstrates strong top-25% performance in multi-core CPU stress tests, Passmark database operations, and Redis SET operations, which reach 88.78 million operations per second. However, memory bandwidth for uncached large block read-only operations and prompt processing for larger 70B LLM models fall into the average middle-50% category.

The E64as_v6 offers high memory density and dedicated compute resources, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large memory footprints without the overhead of local NVMe drives. Given its strong multi-threaded decompression, database operations, and memory write bandwidth, it is suited for relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, enterprise application hosting, and moderate-scale LLM text generation.
